parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of StrPrinter settings not being respected by certain subexpressions, but it introduces a non-minimal change and has potential maintainability issues.

issues.description: The PR makes extensive changes across multiple methods, which increases the risk of introducing bugs or regressions.
The changes introduce more nested calls to `self._print`, which may decrease the readability and maintainability of the code.
